title: What Is a Hypothesis?
hook: A hypothesis is a testable guess.
narration: A hypothesis is a testable guess.
Today's question: What Is a Hypothesis?.
If-then. Measurable. Willing to die if the data say no.
Hold the cause in your head, then the effect.
It is not a vibe and not a proof.
This is the part most people skip. Do not skip it.
Kill your bad guesses early. That is the job.
If you can say why what is a hypothesis works, you understood the film.
No gore. Just the model. School-safe.
The pictures today are a new book world. Not yesterday's film.
Stay to the end. The last shot is the takeaway for what is a hypothesis.
If a grown-up is with you, pause and tell them the cause in one sentence.
Tomorrow a different 3D film. New scene. New true fact.
